bio_en: Kris Fenerjian was an old ARF fighter best known for his part, under the alias Silvo Ricci, in preparing the Yildiz assassination attempt on Sultan Abdul Hamid in 1905. He took part in later ARF work, including the 1907 General Congress period. He spent his last years in France, where he died in Paris on 9 March 1926 at the age of 42, leaving a wife and a child.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Text gives age 42 at death, which implies birth c.1884.
